findings.proposed: no text change (the word is correct); code fix in notifications_render.row_line
findings.reason: The 5-cell time column is padded with str.rjust, which counts code points: 'अभी' is 3 code points but 2 cells, so the stamp paints 4 cells in a 5-cell column and the row's right edge gains one space on rows under a minute old. Hindi is the only locale whose row_now is not ASCII, so only hi shows it.
findings.evidence: render.log: width 40 row 3 '    ▁▃  Plan updated                 अभी ' (trailing pad) vs '                 6m'; cell_len('अभी'.rjust(5)) = 4, cell_len('now'.rjust(5)) = 5; pinned notifications_render.py line 164.
findings.owner: code (local_operator/tui/notifications_render.py), not this catalogue file; does not gate the ledger row

findings.reason: Without the emphatic इसी the section header can be parsed as 'before this week', which is the 'पुराने' section's own range; the fix is the same measured width (10 cells of a 30-cell cap).

Caveat: the current string is byte-identical to the already-audited desktop copy, so fixing it here alone creates a new cross-surface split.

noted_outside_scope.topic: same-fact term split for 'seen in chat'
noted_outside_scope.detail: seen_in_chat says चैट में देखा गया (10 cells) while the desktop catalogue says बातचीत में देखा गया for the same fact; this file itself says बातचीत in six other keys. English also differs (seen in chat vs Seen in conversation), so the glossary table is not violated. बातचीत में देखा गया measures 12 of the 12-cell cap, so the choice buys headroom for the row title rather than being forced.
